brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.requirement: A planter of four cells: four hex bases each holding a planting bin
requirements.evidence: Four hex base (full) pieces in a straight row at q=-1,0,1,2 on level 0, each cell holding a bin.

requirements.requirement: A water pipe runs through the bases so it feeds every cell
requirements.evidence: run:run-1 is a single rigid run entering at the west end of (-1,0) and passing straight through (0,0), (1,0) and (2,0). The configurator accepted the route. Whether water actually reaches each cell depends on how the pipe is fed and used, which the configurator does not check; the pipe is also a closed run with no outlets into the bins.

requirements.requirement: Each of the four cells holds a bin for soil
requirements.evidence: Four hex-bin-third-drain-pill bins, one per cell. The bins are third-depth because the pipe passes through those cells, as the configurator requires.

requirements.requirement: Plants are growing in the planter (soil in the bins with a plant)
requirements.evidence: All four bins are filled with soil (to rim) and planted: basil, mint, parsley and chives (young stage).

finish.summary: Built a 4-cell planter: four hex bases in a row, a single pipe run entering at the west end and passing straight through all four cells, and a drained third-depth pill-hole bin in each cell filled with soil and planted with basil, mint, parsley and chives. check_build is clean (meshClash clear, only an info note about open cap faces). The pipe feeds the cells physically, but the configurator does not model water flow, so whether every cell actually gets water is not verified.

lines.label: Bin, third depth, drained, pill holes

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
